title: Azure AI and Machine Learning Services
description: Discover Azure AI services including Azure OpenAI, Cognitive Services, Azure Machine Learning, and AI Search.
longDescription: This module introduces the AI and machine learning services available on Azure. You will learn about pre-built Cognitive Services for vision, speech, and language, how to deploy GPT models through Azure OpenAI, the end-to-end workflow with Azure Machine Learning Studio, and how to build intelligent search experiences with Azure AI Search and vector search.
whatYouLearn: Understand the purpose and capabilities of Azure Cognitive Services
Use pre-built vision, speech, language, and decision APIs without training models
Deploy and consume GPT models through Azure OpenAI Service with content filters
Navigate Azure Machine Learning Studio, automated ML, pipelines, and endpoints
Build intelligent search experiences with Azure AI Search and vector search
